question: Padma Bhushan awardee Lalgudi Gopala Jayaraman was associated with which of the following musical genres?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Carnatic music**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Lalgudi Gopala Jayaraman** was a renowned violinist, composer, and exponent of **Carnatic music**, a classical music form of Southern India.
 
• He was born on **17 September 1930**, in Lalgudi, Tamil Nadu, into a family deeply rooted in Carnatic music traditions.
 
• He was known for pioneering the **Lalgudi Bani**, a unique style of violin playing that emphasizes melody and lyrical expression.
 
• In recognition of his immense contributions to Indian classical music, he was awarded the prestigious **Padma Bhushan** in 2001.
 
• His compositions include **varnams, kritis, and tillanas**, which are widely performed in the Carnatic music tradition.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Carnatic Music:**

 
 
• Carnatic music is one of the two major traditions of Indian classical music, the other being Hindustani music.
 
• It originated in South India and is known for its intricate compositions and devotional themes.
 
• The key components of Carnatic music include **raga** (melodic framework) and **tala** (rhythmic cycle).
 
 
 
• **Violin in Carnatic Music:**
 
 
• The violin was introduced into Carnatic music in the early 19th century and is now a staple instrument in this tradition.
 
• It is played in a seated posture, with the instrument held horizontally and resting on the player’s ankle.
 
 
 
• **Lalgudi Bani:**
 
 
• Lalgudi Bani is the unique style of violin playing developed by Lalgudi Gopala Jayaraman.
 
• It emphasizes lyrical expression, tonal precision, and a seamless blend of melody and rhythm.
 
 
 
• **Padma Bhushan Award:**
 
 
• The Padma Bhushan is India’s third-highest civilian award, conferred for distinguished service of a high order in any field.
 
• Lalgudi Gopala Jayaraman received this honor in 2001 for his outstanding contributions to Carnatic music.
